response.sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg WHERE avg_feerate IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is an unweighted mean over pairs (each pair counts once), computed across all scopes together, excluding pairs whose average is NULL (all feerate values missing).
Ranking uses ROW_NUMBER (1,2,3,...) with ties broken by orderslink ascending, as the request specifies.
